title: Chapter 861
paragraphs: Chapter 861
Episode 215. Reunion with God (2)
"Understood, I'll go right now. Prepare immediately, Luna, and Luntia."
"We're always ready. Let's go, so-called lord."
Jin immediately wrapped up the meeting and moved to Tikan.
Bringing Luna and Luntia was no other choice. Despite how crude and weak the Peitel he met in the past at Chungsae military road was, he was essentially a higher-level god.
Even if a battle with him unfolds, it would be reassuring if the two were together. Murakan and Valeria were also likely to join.
"Have you arrived, my lord! And all the knights!"
As the Red Owl arrived in Tikan, Jet greeted the party.
"What about Yulian and Kaltor?"
"They're in the treatment room."
Even before entering the treatment room, the party could hear Yulian's weeping voice. Of course, it was a weep that originated from joy, not sadness.
"Tsk...... he has so many eyes to see, but he keeps crying. Stop crying and greet the lord, you crybaby."
Although Beris was spitting out harsh words, he was actually very happy about Kaltor's recovery. The same was true for Kuzan who was standing next to him.
In some sense, these three were no different from the classmates who joined the Vamel Alliance at the same time.

While Kuzan and Beris quickly adapted to life in Tikan, Yulian had not been able to get along well with his colleagues until recently. Of course, he was active in various battles, but without Kaltor's awakening, Yulian was someone who couldn't properly communicate with anyone.
But now that Kaltor has awakened, the curtain has come down on Yulian's long solitude and despair.
"Lord Jin......"
Yulian turned around and looked at Jin, teary-eyed.
"Do you regret coming to Tikan now?"
"I've always felt this way, and I've always been grateful. But now I finally feel like I've regained my entire life."

"That's fortunate. Don't make it too much of a celebration since it's embarrassing. Nice to meet you, Lord Kaltor. We have seen you almost every day since we rescued you in 1799, but I guess this is the first time you're seeing us."
Kaltor stood up from his sickbed and met eyes with Jin. Although he had fully regained his consciousness, his body was very weak due to his long illness.
Jin remembered the miserable state of Kaltor the day he rescued him from Joshua's villa. There were huge nails hammered into his limbs, and his whole body was full of traces of terrible torture.
"You rescued me......"
"It wasn't just me, but also my companions. Yulian also participated in that mission. Afterwards, when we rescued a demon named Ozdok, the seven knights of our Runcandel also participated."
"I don't know how to express my gratitude......"

As he was responding, Kaltor, perhaps overwhelmed by emotion, held Yulian for a moment and burst into tears. The colleagues thought the two were a good match. For these tender-hearted and tearful ones, the period of living as Joshua's hunting dogs was truly hellish.
"Hey, little guy. You're here?"
"Murakan."
"Huh, huh. Murakan!?"
Suddenly hearing Murakan's voice, Kaltor looked at him in surprise.
"What's up, why are you so surprised?"
"Ah, is that... Murakan?"
"Do you know me?"
"There's no dragon who doesn't know Murakan among the dragons."
"Kahaha, that's right. Don't worry, I won't hit you, you're on our side."
"That's... that's a relief."
"But knowing me means you're at least a thousand years old. How old are you?"
"I'm not quite two thousand."
"Oh, were you active a thousand years ago?"
"No, I don't know much about the war from that time. I was hiding following Lord Peitel..."
"Ah... hiding. Well, I see."
During the war between Runcandel and Zephyr a thousand years ago, Peitel, being afraid of the fight, had taken his dragons into hiding.

Murakan, recalling his memories of Peitel, thought it was just like him, but he couldn't bring himself to swear at him in front of Kaltor. For a dragon, swearing at their god was no different from insulting their parents.
No matter how bad they were, it was a rule not to swear at a colleague's parents.
"It happens. Don't be so cautious, it's okay."
"It's... it's because I'm ashamed."
"Huh? What are you ashamed of?"

"Even though I was in hiding due to Peitel's decision, Runcandel saved me even though I had turned my back on them at the time. And the war from that time is still ongoing. Therefore, this time, I'll definitely fight without hiding, even if it goes against Peitel's will...."
Kaltor spoke with a determined look for the first time.
"Ho... You have a wonderful mindset. Even if it's just words saying that a dragon will go against the will of a god, it's not easy to say. You need to have that much will to actually speak it out."
"I heard that Runcandel and Vamel Alliance currently need Peitel's help."
"That's right. That guy's ability to materialize his power into something like a weapon, or the power of the storm itself, may be needed. Yulian, are you able to communicate with Peitel?"
"...No, it's been a long time since I heard Peitel's voice. I haven't heard from him since he was insulted in Cheongsae Gundo by Murakan and Jin."
Murakan nodded thoughtfully. He figured that would make sense, as he would be too embarrassed to communicate with a contractor again if he were in the same situation.

"It may be out of embarrassment, but there could be other reasons. At that time, Peitel vented his anger through me, but still suffered significant damage... He may have been greatly affected, even his main body."
"So, you're suggesting that he could be in recovery?"
"Yes."
"Hmm, so there's no other way to try to communicate with Peitel?"

"Yulian and I have no way to do that here. Yulian has already tried to communicate with Peitel several times to heal me, but he has never been successful. I'm the same. But, I think it might be worth going directly to Cheongsae Gundo."
"Cheongsae Gundo."
There were about a hundred islands in Cheongsae Gundo.
Among them, Jin and Murakan were active on the 32nd island. But that island was completely obliterated without a trace after the battle with Garmund, who was summoned by Joshua and the black light.
Therefore, the tombstone believed to be the tomb of the Thunder God 'Gramm', which was on the 32nd island, also disappeared.

"From what I know, the tomb of a god will not completely disappear as long as the remains or fundamental energy of the corresponding god remains nearby, even if there is a problem with the tombstone or barrier. So, if you go there again, Jin's sword might react to Gramm's energy."
Jin had been worrying about what to do if Kaltor was uncooperative.
From Jin's perspective, it's true that he saved Yulian and Kaltor, but from Kaltor's perspective, his god, who was like a parent to him, might have been hurt by Jin and his colleagues.
But it was a false worry. Kaltor was willing to make a choice for his colleagues over Peitel.

'After all, Peitel didn't do anything when he was tortured and dying... it looks like he wanted to participate in the war a thousand years ago, but he had to hide because of Peitel. It's not strange.'
Kaltor stood up from his seat and put on his clothes.
"I'm ready. We can leave right now."
"You can rest a few more days before you go."
"No, if my combat power is needed, another time would be better. But it seems there are many powerful people here..."
Jin, Murakan, Luna, Luntia.

Among the people in the sick room, if just those four were present, they could subdue Peitel even if he were to reincarnate like before. Even Murakan, who temporarily regained a little strength back then, was enough to overpower Peitel.
Of course, Peitel might reincarnate in a state where he can have a stronger influence on the population than before, but Jin wasn't too worried.
"Then I'll have Red Owl on standby, so come out when you're ready."
"Yes, Lord Jin."

"And you can speak to me casually. It feels awkward to be spoken to in formal language by a dragon that's over two thousand years old. Don't think of me as too difficult. Kaltor, you're a part of Tikan's family too."
"Really...?"
Soon after, Jin, his riders, Valeria, and Murakan were the first to leave the hospital room, followed by Beris and Kuzan.
"Jin."
"Beris?"
"Well... I wanted to say thank you, so I followed you."
Jin's eyes widened. When one thinks of Beris, the image of a cranky, foul-mouthed mentor to Enya comes to mind.
"If it wasn't for you, Kuzan, Yulian, and I would have all ended up as Joshua's hunting dogs, doing garbage work before being abandoned and killed."
"You're being overly sentimental."

"Just seeing that idiot Kaltor crying today... made me feel like I had to say thank you one more time. Then take care. I need to head out to the Garden of Swords to observe the use of magic by the riders and the Magic Knight troops in a couple of hours."

"Thank you, too, Beris. Please take care of them. When you're teaching, don't distinguish between elders, riders, or knights. Curse and thirst for them your way. Tell them it's my order. If they can't follow properly, give them a suitable punishment."
"That's a welcome order. Understood."
A little later, Yulian and Kaltor came out to the launching pad.
As soon as they set the coordinates, the Red Owl transported them in an instant to the area where Island No. 32 of the Blue Bird Archipelago used to be.
"Oh, ugh. Croak!"
"Every time we move... No matter how susceptible dragons are to space travel, other dragons don't do this. Kaltor, who came here with his weakened body, is the same."
"Damn, I can't get used to this feeling. The other dragons probably aren't as sensitive as I am."
"Yes, I guess so."
Looking down from the sky, the Blue Bird Archipelago seemed to have a few islands destroyed from past battles, but overall, it looked like a flock of birds flying.

Since it was winter, the unique thunderstorms and squalls of the Blue Bird Archipelago were not as severe as usual. The party landed the Red Owl in the sea and settled on a large reef where Island No. 32 used to be.
"Pull out your Thunder Sword once... No, pull it out, Jin."
As soon as he drew Sigmund, Jin and the rest of the group were able to immediately confirm the appearance of a rune on the sword's spirit.
"Oh, it's the same rune we saw before. It's Gramm's rune, kiddo. As Kaltor said, it seems that Gramm's power is still lingering here. Uh, Yulian. Why are you suddenly like that?"
At the same time, Yulian flipped his eyes and trembled.
"Is this a precursor symptom of incarnation? Yulian, are you okay?"
"I can hear Master Peitel's voice...!"
"What is she saying?"
After Yulian moistened her lips for a moment, she answered.
"She's... she's asking to be saved... She's asking for help..."
